# `parameter-added-optional`

New optional parameter

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `parameter-added-optional` (all locations), `query-parameter-added-optional`, `header-parameter-added-optional`, `cookie-parameter-added-optional`. Path parameters use `parameter-added-optional`. |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Parameters ([RULES.md section 4](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A new optional query, header or cookie parameter.

## Why this default

Old clients don't send it, and the server uses its default.

## Example

From test case [`parameter-added-optional`](../../test/cases/parameter-added-optional/): A new optional query parameter.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
      get:
        operationId: listPets
-       parameters: []
+       parameters:
+       - name: limit
+         in: query
+         schema:
+           type: string
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `query-parameter-added-optional` · info · GET /pets

## Test cases

2 test cases expect this rule. Each folder has the base and revision documents and the expected findings; they run with `npm test`.

| Test case | Expects | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| [`parameter-added-optional`](../../test/cases/parameter-added-optional/) | `query-parameter-added-optional` · info · GET /pets | A new optional query parameter. |
| [`parameter-renamed`](../../test/cases/parameter-renamed/) | `query-parameter-added-optional` · info · GET /pets | The query parameter limit became max, with the same schema and position. On the wire that is removed + added (old clients send limit); for SDKs it is also parameter-renamed (error under --profile sdk). |

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). See [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  parameter-added-optional: info
```
